content.comment_body: Hello, how can I convert a .bin file to an .lsc file? I am unable to open the .bin file in [product_name] V8.2. Please provide a helpful suggestion.
Open [product_name] and try to load the .bin file. You should be able to save it as an .lsc file afterward.
Please upload the .bin file as a ZIP archive.
Refer to the attached video for assistance.
Hello, can you explain how to do this? Could you share any screenshots?
I tried, but when I attempt to open the file, it displays: { You must use a newer version of this program }
Can you advise on how to upload as a ZIP archive? I copied the .bin file from the SD card because the PLC module is damaged. Do I also need to update my software version?

The file from the SD card is a .bin file named [product_name]_U_P.bin. Zip this file and attach it to your post. In the editor, there is a button labeled 'Add attachment.' Alternatively, rename the .bin file to [product_name]_U_P.bin.zip and then attach it.

I checked the file and performed some tests. The file is corrupt and cannot be loaded in [product_name] versions V7.1.5, V8.0, V8.1.1, V8.2, or V8.2.1. For every attempt, a message appears about needing a newer version. If you insert the card in a [product_name] standard module or the latest [product_name] version, the program will not load. I recommend contacting [company_name] support to have the file examined.

Lack of clarity in file upload instructions and version support complicates the troubleshooting process.
